Readability Scores

Flesch Reading Ease

—

Score out of 100 — higher is easier. Weighs sentence length and syllable count.

Gunning Fog

—

US school grade estimate based on sentence length and complex (3+ syllable) words. Add five for the UK reading age.

SMOG Index

—

US school grade estimate focused on words of three or more syllables. Favoured in healthcare communications.

Email target zone

Aim for a Flesch Reading Ease score of 60 or above and a Gunning Fog / SMOG grade of 8 or below — a reading age of about 13, comfortable for most audiences.

These benchmarks suit broad consumer audiences. For professional, technical, or B2B readers, higher complexity is often appropriate — treat the scores as a starting point, not a rule.

Get expert help

When scores are consistently in the difficult range across all three formulas, the issue often runs deeper than sentence length — it can signal structural complexity in how your messaging is built.
